correctness.rationale: For every coprime positive p,q with q>=2, write n=qk+r. The Bezout matrix [[U,V],[-p,q]] is unimodular and converts gcd(n,floor(pn/q)) to gcd(k+Ur+V floor(pr/q), pr mod q). Nonzero residual values permute 1,...,q-1 and each divides L=lcm(1,...,q-1), so every qL-block has per-fiber counts (L/d)Σ_{j<=floor((q-1)/d)}φ(j)/j. The r=0 fiber contributes indicator(BL<d<=(B+1)L), since gcd(qk,pk)=k. Averaging blocks yields delta_q and lost mass 1/q; Möbius inversion gives fixed-d limit 1/(ζ(2)d²) with O(log q/(dq)). Independently enumerated q=5 reduced numerators and B=0,1,2 with exact agreement.
residual_risks: The q→∞ statement fixes d, and the n→∞ density fixes q first. No joint q,n limit or irrational-slope claim.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The Holdridge theorem requires total homogeneous equidistribution and treats the gcd=1 event, excluding a reduced rational linear slope. The prime-denominator monomial work covers k>=2 and its coprimality indicator only; neither controls this full rational linear histogram.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The irrational equidistribution theorem has an inapplicable hypothesis; rational slopes produce 1/q escaping mass, inconsistent with an all-mass zeta law at fixed q. The other identified sources concern different index pairings or only coprimality.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The floor relation transforms under an SL_2(Z) matrix into gcd(k+c_r,pr mod q); summing over a complete period is invariant under p. This is stronger than the irrational Weyl-equidistributed coprimality limit and stronger than a tabulation of a single gcd=1 density.

originality.rationale: The unimodular residue-class reduction yields exact numerator-independent full gcd histograms on every block of q*lcm(1,...,q-1), including escaping 1/q mass. Prior literature supplies irrational polynomial coprimality densities and p=1 gcd=1 tables; those cannot imply every positive gcd value for every numerator on every finite block.
residual_risks: Sykora 2014 and the 2023 Srichan full articles were not fully material-read: any direct generalization hidden there remains a priority risk; this does not by itself negate the explicit new full-histogram theorem.

value.rationale: The full finite-block gcd histogram of the natural correlated pair (n,floor(pn/q)) is a motivated exact arithmetic invariant: the SL2Z invariance explains why every reduced numerator has identical counts, and the pointwise density loses exactly 1/q mass despite approaching the zeta coprimality profile as q grows. Previous gcd-one tables neither determine every fiber nor the mass-escape mechanism.
residual_risks: Large-block L may be enormous; no claim of efficient all-q simultaneous computation.

limitations: Missing full Sykora/Srichan specialized literature is a residual originality risk, not a correctness defect or automatic originality failure.
